_comment: Issued memo numbers. scripts/build-memo.cjs appends here and takes the next number from it, so an Author File # is never reused. Format is DRR-<number><revision>, e.g. DRR-4A: the number is the memo, the letter is its revision. A letter moves only when an ALREADY PUBLISHED memo is reworked (build with --revise 4); a redraft before it goes out is still A. firstNumber carries the memos issued before this tool existed. file is relative to memos/.
author: Douglas Regehr
